en: A flat, dark thing that hangs from wet yards like a strip of canvas until it drops. You seldom see the first one before it lands.
A hermit crab living in a ship's lamp glass. The thick glass turns fire and blows aside, and it cracks in the cold.
Undertow-spawn tangled in a drowned ship's rigging. It grew its own sails along her shrouds and has hauled her lines ever since.
Ysolde is in reserve. Swap her in on anyone's turn. It costs no time.
Read it to learn what the glass turns aside.
Blows slide off the shroud. Read it, and answer with the right element.
Its weakness has changed. Read it again.
Carved and lacquered, the ship's name in Pemakar terrace script. Taken off a drowned hull to go home. Nobody paid for it.
A called Vowbound takes the party's place until you dismiss him or he falls. Asha's next turn waits the call's cost.
